# 优化B部署:分段写remote_ctl新脚本→校验md5→备份→替换→语法校验。重启单独一条。
TF=/tmp/remote_ctl_new.b64
: > "$TF"
printf '%s' '' >> "$TF"
printf '%s' '' >> "$TF"
printf '%s' '' >> "$TF"
printf '%s' '' >> "$TF"
echo "写入字节=$(wc -c < "$TF")(应为8636)"
base64 -d "$TF" > /tmp/remote_ctl_new.sh 2>/dev/null && echo "解码OK" || echo "解码失败"
echo "新脚本md5=$(md5sum /tmp/remote_ctl_new.sh 2>/dev/null | cut -d\  -f1)(应为42a11a0726721f692258c08b1e5e089e)"
echo "新脚本语法=$(bash -n /tmp/remote_ctl_new.sh 2>&1 && echo OK || echo FAIL)"
echo "=== DEPLOY_B_PREP_DONE ==="
